about_the_game:
This game aims to be a 3D Isometric Bullet-Hell MMORPG with Permadeath and Roguelike Elements inspired by the (now dead) Steambirds Alliance by Spryfox.

This proof of concept version is the early testing singleplayer version of the game, made as a way to showcase to the community about the potential of the project and for learning purposes and experimentation before starting the networking/multiplayer side of coding.

This version contains:
3 Pilots (Blu Jay, Robin and Waddles)
6 Weapons (Machinegun, Energy Sword, Deployable Saw, Sniper, Laser Beam and Cluster Shotgun)
1 Boss battle
1 Testing Map

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Any Distribution (Tested on Ubuntu 22.04.3 LTS)
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-4510U CPU @ 2.00GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Support for OpenGL 3.3
  • Storage: 800 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: This was the minimum tested by devs. Can possibly run on worse conditions
